from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted data for a single university from a Common Data Set document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    social_science_degree_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of Bachelor's degrees conferred in Social Sciences (CIP 45)")
    total_graduate_population: int | None = Field(description="Total number of graduate students enrolled")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Academic year or reporting period associated with the data (e.g., 'Fall 2021', '2020-2021')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: list[UniversityData]
